basic_info.description: Welcome to Penthouse #7F, a spectacular trophy condo offering an unparalleled living experience w/breathtaking views of the iconic GGBridge from every window AND from the private 690sqft roof deck!   Accessed from within the unit, the roof deck showcases amazing views for entertaining or just lounging on the weekends. Set in the heart of SF's vibrant Cow Hollow neighborhood, this contemporary floor plan has an open living/dining area w/walk out balcony with more stunning views! The gourmet kitchen is outfitted w/chic quartz countertops, 6-burner Bertazzoni gas range, Thermador fridge & an expansive breakfast bar. The private lower level has a well-scaled guest bdrm, w/chic full bath, custom CA closet & super luxe primary suite w/views, custom walk-in closet & spa-like bath w/double sink vanity, glass surround shower & soaking tub. Add'l features include high ceilings, in-unit laundry, 1 pkg + storage. Residents enjoy access to the welcoming lounge, common roof deck w/BBQs, fire pit & seating area. Located just steps from the energetic lifestyle of Union St & upper Polk cafes & shops, this spectacular penthouse is also close to Fort Mason, Marina Green & St. Francis Yacht Club. Experience the best of SF living where every detail has been designed for your dream lifestyle!
